title: Girona and Figueres
text: Our guide, Sandra, was amazing! Very informative and even when we got lost going back to the meeting point she waited and found us to take us back to the bus! Girona, was a beautiful city and so happy to have seen the Dali museum in Figueres.

title: Great choice to see Girona and Dalí Museum
text:
I did the Full Day Tour Girona + Dalí Museum with my mother, who is 75 years old, and it was a very nice day. The tour is well organized, with enough time to enjoy everything without running. Girona is a beautiful city, very worth visiting and the universe of the Dalí is truly unique.

Our guide was Nuria, very cheerful, welcoming and clear in the explanations and was very careful with the group, which made the experience even better. I recommend!
author: Laila_Scavone

title: Great experience
text: I loved the tour, Nuria was very friendly and attentive. The explanations were clear and dynamic. I loved the references to Games of Thrones. Thank you Nuria! Good luck in your studies, you'll be a great doctor. And thanks to Manolo (I think that's what the driver was called) for taking us everywhere.
author: mariavV5338JN

title: Great experience - must have!
text: Nuria is the best guide! Girona is a must have. What I would suggest to this tour is to extend the Girona time by an hour to have a proper lunch and walk around the city in the free time.
author: 657maratd

title: One of our favorites!
text: This was such an amazing day trip from Barcelona and probably one of our favorites days from our travels in Spain! Communication prior to  arrival  was organized and it was a very safe and comfortable drive to Girona. Our tour guide, Miri, was wonderful. She was knowledgeable and was very engaging. She not only took us to sites where the show Game of Thrones was filmed but also took us to other major locations and shared interesting facts.
